About premium changes

The displayed premium is based on the recorded details and quote version. Changes to PIN code, age, health or other disclosures, cover, riders, policy term or payment options may change the premium or eligibility. Insurer review may also revise an offer. Review the updated details, price and terms before accepting. After payment, an increase may require an additional payment and a reduction is handled through a tracked refund. All payments and refunds in this preview are simulated.
